_help: Each rule: id, pattern (regex), type (gendered|age|availability|other), severity (high|medium|low), why, rewrite. Penalties are set in severityPenalty.

rules.why: Masculine-coded wording can discourage women and others from applying.
rules.rewrite: Say 'skilled professional' or describe the actual skill needed.

rules.why: 'Aggressive' describing a person is masculine-coded and can put off many candidates.
Age hints exclude experienced candidates and may be discriminatory.
rules.rewrite: Describe the skills or experience needed instead of an age or generation.

rules.why: Restricting to recent graduates can exclude career changers and returners.
rules.rewrite: Say 'entry-level' and welcome career changers and returners.

rules.why: Extreme or unpredictable hours disadvantage caregivers and raise safety concerns for night travel.
rules.rewrite: State the expected working hours and how on-call or overtime is handled and compensated.

rules.why: Gender, marital status or looks should not decide who can apply.
rules.rewrite: Say 'candidates' and describe only the skills and duties of the role.

rules.why: Rules against career gaps or about family background exclude returners, caregivers and many others.
rules.rewrite: Welcome candidates returning from a career break and assess skills only.
